caption: Squads: a team of agents that plan, split and deliver work together
line: Squads let a team of agents plan, split, and deliver work together.

caption: Two ways to build one. The quickest: ask an agent
line: There are two ways to build one. The quickest: just ask an agent.

caption: The agent writes the squad into your project
line: It writes the squad definition straight into your project.

caption: It shows up in Settings → Squads, ready to launch
line: And it shows up in Settings, ready to launch.

caption: Or build it yourself: New squad
line: Or build one yourself. Click New squad, and give it a name.

caption: Add one slot per role, each backed by a persona
line: Add one slot per role: an orchestrator, two workers, and a reviewer.

caption: Crown the orchestrator: it starts first, plans and delegates
line: Crown the orchestrator. It starts first, plans the work, and delegates.

caption: Optional: opening prompt, default project, worktree and launch policy
line: Optionally, set an opening prompt, a project, worktrees, and launch approval.

caption: Saved: your squad is in the catalogue, ready to launch
line: Save it, and your squad joins the catalogue.

caption: Launch: New agent → Squad, then describe the goal
line: To launch, open New agent, choose Squad, and describe the goal.

caption: The orchestrator plans; workers pick up tasks in parallel
line: The orchestrator breaks it into tasks, and workers pick them up in parallel.

caption: Flow view shows who is working and how work hands off
line: Flow view shows who is working, and how work hands off.

caption: When the squad needs a decision, it asks you in the Inbox
line: When the squad needs a decision, it asks you in the Inbox.

caption: Answer once, and the squad finishes the job
line: Answer once, and the squad finishes the job.

caption: Squads: ask an agent or build it yourself, then launch it for any goal
line: Ask an agent, or build it yourself. Then launch it for any goal.
